note: This is the last commit confirmed live in production as of this deploy. Update this file after every deploy made THROUGH this pipeline, so the next build's manifest.previous_commit is accurate.
release_contents: Theme work only: circular reveal (View Transitions + clip-path) replacing the global colour fade, on both the public site and the admin panel. ERP side carries only public/js/provatferi-theme.js and resources/css/provatferi-admin.css — no PHP, Blade, route, config or schema change. Deliberately excludes the separate security-hardening phase, which was not part of this release.
migrations_applied: None. migrate-check reported pending_migrations_detected false and 'Nothing to migrate' — the migration set is byte-identical to the previous release 0abc4ef. migrate-apply was correctly not run.
switch_note: Clean switch: ok:true, atomic_rename_ms 0.243, public asset sync 9.6ms, switched_at 2026-09-19T09:07:02+00:00. config:clear/view:clear/config:cache/view:cache all exit 0. route:cache correctly SKIPPED (routes/ unchanged from previous release) — the tool's own optimisation, not a missed step. No repair script needed.
asset_hash_verification: Independent ground-truth check, not just the switch self-report: admin served /build/assets/provatferi-admin-CDtkcLMZ.css before the switch and /build/assets/provatferi-admin-DaRxOsWR.css after, matching the local Vite build of this commit. The SERVED stylesheet (11188 bytes) was then grepped and contains pf-theme-wipe, --wipe-lead-in, --wipe-r0, --wipe-duration, --wipe-ease, view-transition-new and clip-path. Filename and content were verified as separate claims.
stale_asset_note: The previous hashed stylesheet (provatferi-admin-CDtkcLMZ.css) still returns HTTP 200 after the switch. This is expected, not a defect: deploy/README.md documents the public docroot sync as deliberately non-atomic, with Vite content-hashing letting old and new assets coexist so pages already loaded keep resolving their references. The served HTML references only the new hash.
switch_rename_anomaly: HISTORICAL (release eea9a61dc7c7-2026-09-1711033): `switch` reported {ok:false, error:'atomic rename failed', renamed_old:true, renamed_new:false} while the second rename HAD taken effect — the new tree was already live and serving. If this recurs: do NOT re-run switch blindly — first check whether the live tree is already the new release. The fastest tell is the served hashed asset name, which is how this release was independently verified.
switch_gate_note: release-manager.php `switch` requires stage/build/contract_check/smoke_test_isolated but NOT migrate_apply, even when migrate-check reported pending migrations. Always read migrate-check and run migrate-apply before scheduling switch; never pre-schedule switch on a release that carries migrations.
cron_timing_note: Cron on this host runs in UTC — confirmed this release by scheduling stage/build at specific UTC minutes and observing them fire exactly then. Schedule one-shot crons ~5 minutes ahead of verified server time (HTTP Date header) and always on a specific minute, never `* * * * *`. One empty cron output was observed this release for contract-check; it was re-run rather than assumed passed, and the re-run returned ok:true — treat an empty output as 'did not run', never as success.
upload_url_note: Generate the TUS upload URL for provatferi.org and point HOSTINGER_UPLOAD_URL at .../api/tus/public_html/admin. A URL whose root is public_html alone stages the release into the MAIN site's web root instead. A TUS upload can return 204 with the right Upload-Offset and still not persist the file; always confirm by directory listing. Verified by listing on this release: private.tar 1669120 B, public-assets.tar 153600 B, manifest.json 970 B.
cron_invocation_note: Invoke as `/usr/bin/php /home/u951246149/domains/provatferi.org/laravel-admin-releases/_tooling/release-manager.php <cmd> <releaseId> 2>&1`, one command per cron. Delete each one-shot cron as soon as its output is read; a `switch` cron left armed would rotate directories again on the next firing.
institutional_note: provatferi.org is NOT deployed by this pipeline. It ships as `git archive <sha> -- institutional` (never the working tree, so untracked QA harnesses and media cannot leak), uploaded via TUS to public_html, built with Hostinger's native Node.js archive pipeline (node 22, app_type next, root_directory institutional, output .next, build script build, npm), then a mandatory CDN purge.
